Didn’t realise that the science behind our weather forecasts starts with a balloon! 🎈 

I visited the Meteorological Service Singapore’s Centre for Climate Research Singapore (CCRS) with SMS Janil yesterday to see how our scientists are pushing the frontiers of tropical weather and climate research.

With advanced modelling and data capabilities, CCRS is leading the new Climate and Weather Research Alliance Singapore (CAWRAS), bringing together top research institutions to strengthen Singapore’s expertise in tropical climate and weather systems across Southeast Asia.

A highlight was launching a weather balloon, which collects upper-air data critical to tracking atmospheric changes and understanding long-term climate trends.

As climate risks grow more complex, this work gives us the scientific foundation to make sound, forward-looking decisions for a resilient Singapore.

#ClimateResilience #CAWRAS #WSRP #CCRS #weather

Ever looked at your weather app, saw 30°C, but stepped outside and felt like you were walking into what feels like a sauna? 🥵🌡️

There’s a reason the air temperature and what your body actually feels are miles apart. Think of WBGT, the Wet-Bulb Globe Temperature, as the heat stress index that tells the real story of how your body reacts to heat - beyond what any thermometer can show.

Join me as I chat with Leona, a Senior Meteorologist with the Meteorological Service Singapore, to unpack the science behind the WBGT and why it’s so important to understand how heat stress affects our health. 

I’d also like to encourage everyone to download the myENV app to check the latest WBGT readings before heading out. With real-time environmental data at your fingertips, you can plan your time outdoors more safely! ☀️💧

🔗 Download the myENV app on the App Store or Google Play now!

Singapore imports 90% of its food. In a world of global disruptions, going green isn’t just a lifestyle trend. It is about survival.
